meaning:
προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;]
to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), Act.22:25.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When they had tied him up with thongs, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”
